notes:
Summary: mid-market contact center vendor looking to add RAG-based agent assist + ticket summarization. Strong focus on verifiable citations and freshness. Multi-source retrieval: Zendesk + Confluence + S3+CRM (Salesforce) needed.

Recent activity:
- 2026-02-18: Kickoff call (Alyssa/Marco/Eng lead). Scope: 30-day POC, dataset = last 3 months of tickets (~28k), product KB (Confluence), and release notes in S3. Fireflies id ff_2026-02-18_mariner_poc_kickoff.
- 2026-02-25: Tech deep-dive w/ infra (SE: Marco). Discussed architecture: vector DB choices, embedding offline pipeline, nightly retrain, TTL for freshness.
- 2026-03-03: Demo of retrieval baseline (internal): recall ~0.72 on dev set; hallucination rate flagged on edge cases. Created ticket CCSUP-4123 to triage bad citations.
- 2026-03-10: Security walkthrough with InfoSec, raised SAML attribute mapping and retention policy questions (ff_2026-03-10_security_walkthrough). Legal requested data residency matrix.

Use-case & requirements (customer-speak / shorthand):
- Primary: agent assist (real-time suggested replies + citations) for live chat and voice agent transcripts. Need citations shown to agent with source anchors and link-to-doc.
- Secondary: nightly automated ticket summarization (concise TL;DR + key metadata extraction). Integrate back to Zendesk via tool-calls to update ticket fields.
- Must support tool-calling: create/update ticket, escalate to queue, attach KB links. Expect auth via OAuth + API proxy.
- RAG specifics: multi-source retrieval (Confluence pages, Zendesk articles, S3 release notes, Salesforce KB), support per-source freshness TTL (release notes = 24h, tickets = 6h, Confluence = 48h).
- Citations: return ranked sources with snippet offsets, do not hallucinate source names. Need deterministic reranker & provenance meta.
- Latency/throughput targets: median end-to-end retrieval+answer < 250ms for agent UI (95th < 700ms during normal load). Must sustain spikes: 10k concurrent chats during campaigns (peak QPS ~1500).
- Cost sensitivity: prefer hybrid routing — hosted for low-volume dev, Dedicated for pilot scale, Private for production (data residency). Need Optimize recommendations to reduce token cost by 30% vs current baseline.
- Reliability: graceful degradation — when vector DB lagging, fall back to keyword search + short disclaimer.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency, and alerting on freshness/regression.

Technical preferences & constraints:
- Embeddings: open-model embeddings preferred (cost), but evaluate Redwood-verified profiles for cross-encoder reranker.
- Vector store: evaluating Pinecone vs self-hosted FAISS on Dedicated; need nightly rebuilds to S3 and incremental updates.
- Chunking: 1k-2k token chunk policy; need overlap control to preserve citation granularity.
- Streaming: want streaming partial citations to agent UI to reduce perceived latency.
- Security: SOC2/ISO27001 required for production; must support enterprise KMS and audit logs. Data residency: EU for EU customers.

POC plan (agreed):
- Week 0: Access grants (Zendesk export + Confluence dump + sample S3).
- Week 1: Indexing & baseline retriever (embeddings + simple BM25 baseline). Measure recall/latency.
- Week 2: Integrate reranker, implement citation anchors, tool-calling prototype to update tickets.
- Week 3: Load/cost testing — simulate 1k QPS and a 10k concurrent spike; measure autoscaling behavior.
- Week 4: Security review closeout, success criteria: citation precision > 0.8, median latency < 250ms, cost-per-1000-req within target.

Notes / Quotes from stakeholders:
- CPO: "We can't ship if agents don't trust the sources — citations must be first-class."
- Head of Ops: "Peak reliability during product launches is non-negotiable; we need predictable autoscaling and fallbacks."
- Lead SRE: "Nightly vector builds must not saturate bandwidth; incremental deltas preferred."

Open questions / Blockers (short):
- Legal wants explicit retention TTLs for indexed ticket text.
- SSO: mapping SAML attributes for pilot group failing in test.
- Need clarifications on which SLA tier (dedicated vs private) for EU tenancy.

Next steps (short):
- Alyssa to share Redwood POC checklist + sample connector guide (done).
- Marco to schedule POC start (awaiting infra creds).
- Priya to open procurement thread for Dedicated pilot (internal).
- Customer to provide Zendesk creds and 30k ticket export (expected by 2026-03-18).
